Tour of Britain 2026

Tim Wellens won the 86th edition of the Tour of Britain, with Lewis Askey and Jasper Stuyven joining him on the final podium. The race got underway on Wednesday 2 September 2026 and concluded on Sunday 6 September.

Final GC 2026 Tour of Britain

1. Tim Wellens
2. Lewis Askey + 0:42
3. Jasper Stuyven + 1:03
4. Daan Hoole s.t.
5. Rick Pluimers + 1:15

Discover the route and start list for the Tour of Britain.

Another interesting read: winners and records Tour of Britain.

Tour of Britain 2026 stages:

datum start - finish km el. gain type winner leeder
1 2-9 Lincoln - Lincoln 182.5 1,393 flat Askey Askey
2 3-9 Boston - Skegness 180.2 873 flat Merlier Askey
3 4-9 Hull - Beverley 194.1 1,621 flat Kooij Askey
4 5-9 Helmsley - Leyburn 165.8 2,699 hills Bol Wellens
5 5-9 Earlston - Earlston 156.1 2,236 hills Politt Wellens

Route

The Tour of Britain is a race for puncheurs and sprinters who don’t shy away from a bit of climbing. Across five days, the riders face 8,822 metres of elevation gain. Who will succeed Romain Grégoire as overall winner?
Read more »

Riders

Ethan Vernon, Tim Wellens, Olav Kooij, Tim Merlier, Florian Vermeersch and Filippo Ganna are all riding the Tour of Britain. Who else is on the start list?
Read more »

Winners and records

The origins of the Tour of Britain date back to 1945. Although different events have been held under this name, the current edition is in place as of 2004. The route typically takes in a mix of flat and hilly stages, and an occasional individual time trial. Cyclingstage.com brings you the records and recent winners.
